retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait of a performer set against a dark background with layered, textured graffiti and sharp serif typography.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white portrait with red accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic, low-key portrait of a male figure holding a microphone, rendered in high-contrast black and white with deep shadows. The background is a pitch-black void filled with faint, distressed typographic textures in dark red and grey. A central typographic lockup uses a mix of clean sans-serif and large, beveled serif fonts with a red-to-white gradient.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast subject against a textured dark void
Monochrome figure punctuated by selective red highlights
Clean foreground typography vs. chaotic background graffiti
Diagonal composition following the subject's arm and microphone
coreInvariants: Deep black background with zero detail in the corners
High-frequency texture in the background text/graffiti
Metallic or beveled treatment on the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile portrait occupying the left and center, angled diagonally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hand holding the microphone, highlighted by strong rim lighting.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the microphone, follows the arm down to the torso, then moves right to the primary text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the subject and text, creating a claustrophobic, intense mood.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Red (background text and gradient in main title)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with very low saturation, except for the targeted red accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical Roman serif and modern geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses high-contrast serifs with sharp terminals
Secondary text uses wide-tracked, all-caps sans-serif
Background text uses distressed, hand-drawn or stencil-like forms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Main title features a vertical red-to-white gradient fill
Main title has a subtle metallic bevel effect

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the right side of the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for impact paired with wide-tracked sans-serif for modern elegance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp, classical serif look of the main title.
Provides the clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a male rapper in profile holding a microphone. Use dramatic rim lighting. The background should be solid black with faint, dark red distressed graffiti-style text layered behind the subject.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, beveled serif font with a vertical red-to-white gradient. Below it, add secondary text in a small, white, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the background text sufficiently dark and distressed?
Does the main title have a visible bevel and gradient?
Is the subject lighting high-contrast with deep blacks?
Is the sans-serif text tracking wide enough?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red accent color
Amount of rim lighting on the subject
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Identifiable facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the background is true black (#000000) at the edges.
Check that the red gradient in the text is vibrant but not glowing.
Verify that the subject's profile is clearly defined by light.
Confirm the background text looks like a texture rather than readable content.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome portrait + dark red distressed background text + beveled serif display type + wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle.
